title: WIRING DIAGRAM-BODY & TAIL LAMP
summary: Rear body wiring, right side, all models (sheet D8): RH door ajar warning switch, glove compartment lamp and switch, fuel tank meter (fuel gauge sending unit), RH side marker lamp, RH backing (back-up) lamp, RH tail/stop/turn lamp (outboard) and license plate lamp, with grounds. Includes the legend: solid line = Chevrolet wiring, dashed = Chevrolet RPO wiring. Continues down to D7.
notes_internal: Revision 1 marker (circled 1) is on the 20 R wire to the glove compartment lamp; old wire was 20 OR (wire spec, 'was' left null). AUTH 25948, DR RS, CK CI.
Sheet number K259 printed at lower left.
Wiring diagram: no callout list, part numbers, torques or materials; fastening empty because nothing is fastened on this sheet.
Wire routes are not traced in the tables; only sheet-edge wire lists and wires labelled at a component are listed.
Title block: drawing 3965172, 1970 CORVETTE SERIES, L-93230, DR RT/CI, CK 4-18-69 CI, PREL/C-O D8 3-12-69.
